_nota: Inglés de `data_sharing.json` (`core/i18n.py`): castellano exacto → inglés, valor entero por valor entero. El fichero castellano no se toca; las claves, los ids y las frases literales de una fuente no se traducen. Lo aplica `i18n.localized` al servir.

strings.Qué sale de este equipo, qué ve Tierra y: What leaves this computer, what Earth sees and what stays on board or in this console, by type of data. Each row says whether the code enforces it; when not entirely, it says so and why. In this prototype the two consoles run on the same machine: there is no real link with Earth, and the delay is applied by requesting the data up to a cut-off.
strings.Lo ve Tierra, con el retardo: Earth sees it, with the delay
strings.Solo salen consultas de datos públicos,: Only queries for public data go out, for the purposes below and to their hosts. Before going out, the address and the query pass through the Polaris edge control: no health data and no decoy go out. With offline mode or safe mode nothing goes out.
strings.JPL Horizons sale por astroquery, con su: JPL Horizons goes out through astroquery, with its own library: the gate authorizes before the call, but the gate does not make the request. The test that no other module opens an HTTP client walks backend/app/, not the Polaris copy.
strings.La aplicación compilada solo se conecta: The built application only connects to its own origin (the CSP says connect-src 'self'): the usage log that MediaPipe sends to Google does not go out.
strings.En desarrollo (npm run dev) no hay CSP;: In development (npm run dev) there is no CSP; only blockForeignFetch for fetch, and only once the camera or the listening is turned on.
strings.El borrador de ecografía y el asistente: The ultrasound draft and the assistant talk to Ollama on this computer. A model address that is not on this same computer (loopback) is rejected when the client is created.
strings.Lecturas, diario, dolor, pruebas y estad: Readings, diary, pain, tests and status
strings.Cada observación se firma a bordo en el: Each observation is signed on board in the chained ledger. The Earth console sees it once one light time has passed since its timestamp: it requests the routes that accept it, listed below, up to the cut-off (the onboard time minus the one-way delay), and anything later is neither drawn nor counted. With the simulated link with Earth declared down on board, the cut-off stays at the outage: what is signed afterwards waits on board, is counted as pending to send and reaches Earth, in the order in which it was signed, one light time after the link is declared restored (/api/link-sync). The status, the alerts and the recommendations shown on Earth come from what has already arrived.
strings.El corte lo pide la consola de Tierra: e: The cut-off is requested by the Earth console: the backend serves without a cut-off to whoever does not ask for one and authenticates no one. In this prototype the two consoles run on the same machine and there is no real downlink: the link outage is declared by a person and simulated, not measured.
strings.EMMA no tiene notas marcadas como person: EMMA has no notes marked as personal. Everything that is signed (the diary, a pain report and its note, who acknowledges an alert) goes to the onboard ledger, and the Earth console can see it when it arrives.
strings.No hay forma de reservar una nota solo p: There is no way to keep a note for the crew only. If it is needed, it is a pending decision, not something EMMA does today.
strings.Notas de Tierra a bordo: Notes from Earth to the crew
strings.Las firma Tierra y llegan a bordo con el: Earth signs them and they arrive on board with the delay: on board they are requested up to the clock minus one light time, and what is signed afterwards is neither delivered nor counted.
strings.El corte lo pide la consola de a bordo;: The cut-off is requested by the onboard console; the backend delivers everything to whoever does not ask for one.
strings.Se piden a bordo, se firman en el regist: They are requested on board, signed in the ledger as a draft (the blocked ones, without their text) and do not enter the analysis or an alert. The Earth console does not have the drafts panel.
strings.Que Tierra no los vea es porque su conso: Earth does not see them because its console does not request them: the backend gives them to whoever asks, without a cut-off.
strings.Informes escaneados, ecografías y volúme: Scanned reports, ultrasound scans and volumes
strings.El original se guarda firmado a bordo y: The original is stored signed on board and its text is read with OCR on this computer. The Earth console does not open those panels: it sees the signed measurements of an ultrasound scan and the figures of a lab report that a person confirmed, like any other reading.
strings.Que Tierra no vea el original es porque: Earth does not see the original because its console does not request it: the backend gives it to whoever asks.
strings.Los últimos turnos viven en la memoria d: The latest turns live in the page's memory, not in the browser storage, and are erased when the console or the crew member is changed and when privacy is turned on. Each turn sends them to the backend on this computer, which answers and writes nothing in the ledger.
strings.Lo oye Vosk dentro del navegador, en mem: Vosk hears it inside the browser, in memory, and it is neither recorded nor sent. The Vosk model ships in the package.
strings.Lo dice el módulo de la escucha; esta ta: The listening module says so; this table has no test that checks it. Not tested with a person or with the noise of a spacecraft.
strings.Se graba hasta el silencio o el tope y v: It is recorded until silence or the limit and goes to the backend on this computer, which converts it to Ogg in a temporary folder that is deleted and transcribes it with Whisper here. The audio is not stored.
strings.La cámara solo se enciende con «Seguir l: The camera only turns on with «Follow the face (demo)» and privacy turns it off. The video does not enter the page: no frame is drawn, stored or sent; only the angle of the line between the eyes is used. Video is requested without audio.
strings.Que ningún fotograma se guarde lo asegur: That no frame is stored is ensured by the module's design; this table has no test that checks it.
strings.Baja visión, esencial, giro, voz y priva: Low vision, essential, rotation, voice and privacy are kept in the browser storage of this computer; they do not pass through the ledger or reach the backend.
strings.Tapa en esta pantalla nombres, cifras pe: It hides names, personal figures and notes on this screen, and turns off the camera and the listening. It does not change what is stored or what Earth sees: it is for whoever is looking at the screen.
strings.Las trazas y las líneas de acceso no lle: The logs and the access lines carry no personal content: the query of an address is omitted and an exception leaves only its type and its location.
strings.Una línea por petición con la hora, el p: One line per request with the time, the purpose, the host, the path and the verdict; not the query or the body. It is kept in this computer's cache.
strings.La ventana de fechas y la clave de la AP: The date window and the API key.
strings.Series continuas de flujo de protones (G: Continuous series of proton flux (GOES) and solar wind, from CCMC iSWA (NASA) over HAPI.
strings.El conjunto de datos público, sus paráme: The public dataset, its parameters and the date window.
strings.Dosis medidas en vuelo, de RadLab (OSDR): In-flight radiation dose measurements, from RadLab (OSDR).
strings.La nave, el instrumento y la ventana de: The spacecraft, the instrument and the date window.
strings.La ficha de los estudios de OSDR que EMM: The record of the OSDR studies that EMMA cites, to compare it with EMMA's own.
The public identifier of the study (e.g. OSD-288).
strings.Posiciones de JPL Horizons, para el tiem: Positions from JPL Horizons, for the light time: the days that the local computation (SPICE) does not cover and the preload, which serves as a cross-check.
strings.Solo el guion que descarga los núcleos S: Only the script that downloads the public SPICE kernels from NAIF (JPL) to compute the delay offline; the application does not go out this way.
strings.Posición de la ISS de SSCweb (NASA), sol: ISS position from SSCweb (NASA), only with the low Earth orbit profile.
strings.El identificador público de la ISS, dos: The public identifier of the ISS, two instants and the coordinate system.
strings.Comprobar en su registro la cita con que: Checking in its registry the citation with which a draft is signed, and cross-checking against NTRS the NASA technical reports of the evidence registry.
strings.El identificador citado (PMID, DOI, NCT: The identifier cited (PMID, DOI, NCT or NTRS number).
strings.Solo los guiones de validación descargan: Only the checking scripts download a dataset; the application does not go out this way.
strings.La cita del día de la hoja diaria del pl: The quote of the day of the planner's daily sheet (Marplanner); only with network, not in offline mode.
strings.Nada nuestro: la petición es la cita de: Nothing of ours: the request is today's quote, without parameters.
strings.Las efemérides «tal día como hoy» de la: The «on this day» events of the planner's daily sheet (Marplanner); only with network.
strings.El mes y el día de hoy, y el idioma de l: Today's month and day, and the language of the sheet (English or Spanish).
strings.«Actualizar EMMA»: comprobar si hay una: «Update EMMA»: check whether a new version is published on GitHub and download its installer, only when the person asks for it and never in offline mode.
strings.La dirección del manifiesto de la versió: The address of the version's manifest and of its installer.
strings.Las rutas que aceptan el corte del retar: The routes that accept the delay cut-off (until). Earth requests what goes down up to its cut-off; on board, the notes that Earth sends up are requested up to theirs.
